passages.text: In the last days the mountain of the house of the LORD will be established as the chief of the mountains; it will be raised above the hills, and the peoples will stream to it.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God has a house.
The house of the LORD stands on a mountain.
The mountain of the house of the LORD will be established.
This will happen in the last days.
The mountain will stand at the top of the mountains.
It will be raised above the hills.
Many peoples will come to it.
The peoples will stream to the mountain of the LORD.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֗ים יִ֠הְיֶה הַ֣ר בֵּית־ יְהוָ֤ה נָכוֹן֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הֶהָרִ֔ים וְנִשָּׂ֥א ה֖וּא מִגְּבָע֑וֹת וְנָהֲר֥וּ עָלָ֖יו עַמִּֽים׃

passages.text: And many nations will come and say: “Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us His ways, so that we may walk in His paths.” For the law will go forth from Zion and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Many nations will come.
They will say, “Let us go up to the mountain of the LORD.
Let us go to the house of the God of Jacob.
He will teach us His ways.
We will walk in His paths.
The law will go out from Zion.
The word of the LORD will go out from Jerusalem.”
passages.original: וְֽהָלְכ֞וּ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֗ים וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ לְכ֣וּ׀ וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶל־ הַר־ יְהוָ֗ה וְאֶל־ בֵּית֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיוֹרֵ֙נוּ֙ מִדְּרָכָ֔יו וְנֵלְכָ֖ה בְּאֹֽרְחֹתָ֑יו כִּ֤י מִצִּיּוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֣א תוֹרָ֔ה וּדְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: Then He will judge between many peoples and arbitrate for strong nations far and wide. Then they will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will no longer take up the sword against nation, nor will they train anymore for war.
passages.sermon:
The LORD will judge between many peoples.
He will decide disputes for strong nations that are far away.
People will beat their swords into plowshares.
They will turn their spears into pruning hooks.
No nation will lift up a sword against another nation.
No one will learn war anymore.
passages.original: וְשָׁפַ֗ט בֵּ֚ין עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים וְהוֹכִ֛יחַ לְגוֹיִ֥ם עֲצֻמִ֖ים עַד־ רָח֑וֹק וְכִתְּת֨וּ חַרְבֹתֵיהֶ֜ם לְאִתִּ֗ים וַחֲנִיתֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ לְמַזְמֵר֔וֹת לֹֽא־ יִשְׂא֞וּ גּ֤וֹי אֶל־ גּוֹי֙ חֶ֔רֶב וְלֹא־ יִלְמְד֥וּן ע֖וֹד מִלְחָמָֽה׃

passages.text: And each man will sit under his own vine and under his own fig tree, with no one to frighten him. For the mouth of the LORD of Hosts has spoken.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is God.
God has spoken.
Each man will sit under his own vine.
Each man will sit under his own fig tree.
No one will frighten him.
passages.original: וְיָשְׁב֗וּ אִ֣ישׁ תַּ֧חַת גַּפְנ֛וֹ וְתַ֥חַת תְּאֵנָת֖וֹ וְאֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד כִּי־ פִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת דִּבֵּֽר׃

passages.text: Though each of the peoples may walk in the name of his god, yet we will walk in the name of the LORD our God forever and ever.
passages.sermon:
Many peoples follow their own gods.
Each person walks in the name of his own god.
But we walk in the name of the LORD.
The LORD is our God.
We will walk in His name forever.
We will walk in His name always.
passages.original: כִּ֚י כָּל־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים יֵלְכ֕וּ אִ֖ישׁ בְּשֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהָ֑יו וַאֲנַ֗חְנוּ נֵלֵ֛ךְ בְּשֵׁם־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃פ

passages.text: “On that day,” declares the LORD, “I will gather the lame; I will assemble the outcast, even those whom I have afflicted.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
He says, “On that day, I will act.”
I will gather the lame.
I will assemble the outcast.
I will bring together those I have afflicted.
passages.original: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֗ה אֹֽסְפָה֙ הַצֹּ֣לֵעָ֔ה וְהַנִּדָּחָ֖ה אֲקַבֵּ֑צָה וַאֲשֶׁ֖ר הֲרֵעֹֽתִי׃

passages.text: And I will make the lame into a remnant, and the outcast into a strong nation. Then the LORD will rule over them in Mount Zion from that day and forever.
passages.sermon:
God speaks these words.
God will act with power and mercy.
God will make the lame people into a remnant.
God will make the outcast people into a strong nation.
The LORD will rule over these people.
The LORD will rule from Mount Zion.
The LORD will rule from that day onward.
The LORD will rule forever.
passages.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י אֶת־ הַצֹּֽלֵעָה֙ לִשְׁאֵרִ֔ית וְהַנַּהֲלָאָ֖ה לְג֣וֹי עָצ֑וּם וּמָלַ֨ךְ יְהוָ֤ה עֲלֵיהֶם֙ בְּהַ֣ר צִיּ֔וֹן מֵעַתָּ֖ה וְעַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃פ

passages.text: And you, O watchtower of the flock, O stronghold of the Daughter of Zion— the former dominion will be restored to you; sovereignty will come to the Daughter of Jerusalem.”
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Jerusalem.
He calls them the watchtower of the flock.
He calls them the stronghold of the Daughter of Zion.
God promises to restore their former rule.
He will bring back their first dominion.
He will give sovereignty to the Daughter of Jerusalem.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה מִגְדַּל־ עֵ֗דֶר עֹ֛פֶל בַּת־ צִיּ֖וֹן עָדֶ֣יךָ תֵּאתֶ֑ה וּבָאָ֗ה הַמֶּמְשָׁלָה֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה מַמְלֶ֖כֶת לְבַ֥ת־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: Why do you now cry aloud? Is there no king among you? Has your counselor perished so that anguish grips you like a woman in labor?
passages.sermon:
The people of Jerusalem cry out loudly.
They feel great distress.
They have no king to lead them.
They have lost their counselor.
They feel anguish.
Their pain is strong, like a woman in labor.
passages.original: עַתָּ֕ה לָ֥מָּה תָרִ֖יעִי רֵ֑עַ הֲמֶ֣לֶךְ אֵֽין־ בָּ֗ךְ אִֽם־ יוֹעֲצֵךְ֙ אָבָ֔ד כִּֽי־ הֶחֱזִיקֵ֥ךְ חִ֖יל כַּיּוֹלֵדָֽה׃

passages.text: Writhe in agony, O Daughter of Zion, like a woman in labor. For now you will leave the city and camp in the open fields. You will go to Babylon; there you will be rescued; there the LORD will redeem you from the hand of your enemies!
passages.sermon:
The Daughter of Zion is God's people in Jerusalem.
God commands the Daughter of Zion to writhe in agony.
She must suffer like a woman in labor.
Now she will leave the city.
She will live in the open fields.
She will go to Babylon.
There she will be rescued.
There the LORD will redeem her.
The LORD will save her from the hand of her enemies.
passages.original: ח֧וּלִי וָגֹ֛חִי בַּת־ צִיּ֖וֹן כַּיּֽוֹלֵדָ֑ה כִּֽי־ עַתָּה֩ תֵצְאִ֨י מִקִּרְיָ֜ה וְשָׁכַ֣נְתְּ בַּשָּׂדֶ֗ה וּבָ֤את עַד־ בָּבֶל֙ שָׁ֣ם תִּנָּצֵ֔לִי שָׁ֚ם יִגְאָלֵ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה מִכַּ֖ף אֹיְבָֽיִךְ׃

passages.text: But now many nations have assembled against you, saying, “Let her be defiled, and let us feast our eyes on Zion.”
passages.sermon: Many nations have gathered against you.\r\nThey say, “Let her be defiled.”\r\nThey say, “Let us look at Zion.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֛ה נֶאֶסְפ֥וּ עָלַ֖יִךְ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֑ים הָאֹמְרִ֣ים תֶּחֱנָ֔ף וְתַ֥חַז בְּצִיּ֖וֹן עֵינֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: But they do not know the thoughts of the LORD or understand His plan, for He has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor.
passages.sermon:
The nations do not know the thoughts of the LORD.
They do not understand His plan.
The LORD has gathered the nations together.
He gathers them like bundles of grain at the threshing floor.
passages.original: וְהֵ֗מָּה לֹ֤א יָֽדְעוּ֙ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א הֵבִ֖ינוּ עֲצָת֑וֹ כִּ֥י קִבְּצָ֖ם כֶּעָמִ֥יר גֹּֽרְנָה׃

passages.text: Rise and thresh, O Daughter of Zion, for I will give you horns of iron and hooves of bronze to break to pieces many peoples. Then you will devote their gain to the LORD, their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Zion.
Zion is the city of God’s people.
God calls Zion “Daughter of Zion.”
God commands Zion to rise up.
God tells Zion to thresh.
God promises to give Zion horns made of iron.
God promises to give Zion hooves made of bronze.
Zion will use these to break many nations into pieces.
Zion will take the wealth of these nations.
Zion will give this gain to the LORD.
Zion will give their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.
passages.original: ק֧וּמִי וָד֣וֹשִׁי בַת־ צִיּ֗וֹן כִּֽי־ קַרְנֵ֞ךְ אָשִׂ֤ים בַּרְזֶל֙ וּפַרְסֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ אָשִׂ֣ים נְחוּשָׁ֔ה וַהֲדִקּ֖וֹת עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְהַחֲרַמְתִּ֤י לַֽיהוָה֙ בִּצְעָ֔ם וְחֵילָ֖ם לַאֲד֥וֹן כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
